title: Language Model Integration
summary: This module centralizes all functionalities for interacting with Language Models (LLMs) in DSPy, providing core client interfaces, caching mechanisms, streaming capabilities, and provider-specific integrations for various LLM services. It abstracts away LLM complexities to offer a unified and efficient interaction layer.

nodes.label: Manage Core LLM Clients
nodes.title: Core LLM Client Interfaces
nodes.description: Provides the foundational interfaces for interacting with various Language Models, handling request formatting, response parsing, and basic LM operations.

nodes.label: Cache LLM Calls & Embeddings
nodes.title: Caching & Embedding Services
nodes.description: Manages caching for expensive LLM calls and embedding computations, ensuring efficient reuse of results and secure disk serialization.

nodes.label: Handle LLM Response Streaming
nodes.title: LLM Response Streaming
nodes.description: Enables incremental streaming of LLM outputs, providing real-time feedback and utilities for processing and formatting streamed content.

nodes.label: Integrate Provider-Specific Features
nodes.title: Provider-Specific Integrations
nodes.description: Offers specialized integrations for different LLM providers, including logging control and management of finetuning jobs for platforms like Databricks and OpenAI.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Application Logic
nodes.description: The main DSPy program or module that orchestrates calls to Language Models and utilizes their capabilities.

nodes.label: External LLM APIs
nodes.title: Third-Party Language Models
nodes.description: Represents the actual external Language Model services (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, local LLMs) that DSPy clients communicate with.

nodes.label: External Storage/Data
nodes.title: External Data Storage
nodes.description: External systems for storing cached data, finetuning datasets, or models, accessed by caching and provider modules.

groups.label: Core LLM Abstraction
groups.title: Central LLM Interface
groups.description: The foundational layer for all Language Model interactions within DSPy, abstracting various LLM APIs.

groups.label: LLM Interaction Enhancements
groups.title: Optimizing LLM Interactions
groups.description: Modules that add performance, responsiveness, and data management capabilities to LLM interactions, such as caching and streaming.

groups.label: Provider-Specific Management
groups.title: Tailored LLM Provider Control
groups.description: Handles unique features and management tasks specific to different Language Model providers, including logging and finetuning.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Systems & Data
groups.description: Represents external components like DSPy programs, third-party LLM services, and data storage that interact with this integration layer.
